summary.text: Jerry Cirino is serving his second term in the Ohio Senate, representing District 18, which covers Lake County and portions of Cuyahoga County. He chairs the Senate Finance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before the Senate, Cirino spent four years as a Lake County Commissioner. His career in business included many years leading companies in the medical device industry, and he was the founding CEO of SourceOne Healthcare Technologies in Mentor.
He also co-founded MyBoard Advisors, a consulting firm that helps small businesses.

Cirino sponsored Senate Bill 1 of the 136th General Assembly and Senate Bill 135 of the 134th, both higher education bills that are now law, and chaired the Finance Committee during the most recent operating budget process.
He holds a Bachelor of Science in Business and an MBA from Lake Erie College and previously chaired the board of trustees of Lakeland Community College.
Cirino and his wife, Donna, have been married for 52 years and raised nine children in Lake County.
